Container.Name: scopearr
Container.Overview: Filter your Radarr and Sonarr media library using existing filenames and API metadata. Local SQLite cache. No media mounts required. Optional: mount media shares read-write to remove or edit tracks with MKVToolNix (downloaded into Appdata). One local admin login. Configure API connections in the WebUI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: WebUI port on the dedicated container IP.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Local SSD/pool path. No SMB/NFS. Owner must match UID/GID in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: HTTPS proxy
Config.Description: Set true only when the browser accesses this app through HTTPS.

Config.Name: Go memory target
Config.Description: Soft Go memory target, clamped to one quarter of the container memory limit to retain headroom.

Config.Name: Go CPU parallelism
Config.Description: Limit Go execution threads to two by default.

Config.Name: Media (optional, MKVToolNix)
Config.Description: Only for track editing. Mount your Radarr/Sonarr media share, e.g. /mnt/user/data/media. Map Arr path => /media/... under Settings → Services → MKVToolNix. Allow UID 99/GID 100 to write. Never mount media under /data (Appdata).
